Occurrences.Kwic: 舉：石頭因藥山問：三乘十二分教，某甲粗知。常聞南方直指人心，見性成佛，實未明了。望和尚慈悲指示。頭云：恁麼也不得，不恁麼也不得，恁麼不恁麼總不得。汝作麼生會？山佇思。頭云：子因緣不在此，江西見馬大師去。山至祖處，復如前問。祖云：我有時教伊揚眉瞬目是，有時教伊揚眉瞬目不是。

Occurrences.Kwic: 正恁麼時，文殊三處度夏即不問，至諸佛集處，因甚出女人定不得？小處多官府，空山有鬼神。結夏，小參。集方儲藥，病者愈多；剖㪷折衡，爭端益盛。恁麼也不得，不恁麼也不得，恁麼不恁麼總不得，然後徑山與諸人向沒交涉處同此受用、同此安居，忘彼忘此，非實非虗，二時粥飯氣力麤，試問諸人會也無？除夜，小參。舊歲即新歲，新年即舊年，要知新歲歲，元是舊年年。

Occurrences.Kwic: 若據本分相見，眨上眉毛，蹉過久矣。且如釋迦掩室，已涉繁詞；居士默然，囊錐已露。須信道：恁麼也不得，不恁麼也不得，恁麼不恁麼總不得。若向箇裏轉得過來，便乃拽轉祖師鼻孔，不歷古佛階梯，向函蓋乾坤處隨波逐浪，向隨波逐浪處却能截斷眾流。然雖如是，且道：舉一明三一句作麼生道？

Occurrences.Kwic: 小參心有一法，在處不安；心無一法，未免顢頇。有無心不著，畢竟是何端？江山礙眼情非瞥，心境居胸識未乾。故恁麼也不得，不恁麼也不得，恁麼不恁麼總不得，透過三句外，自然與佛無差，橫行也得，直行也得，無能攔攩，殺也不怕，活也不怕，豈解傷鋒？為伊有通霄路徑，行於鳥道，何處覔蹤？繇似幻人，把捉伊不住，佛祖尚不柰何，況天堂地獄耶？

Occurrences.Kwic: 然雖如是，此段靈機，聖賢若知，即同凡夫；凡夫若會，即是聖賢。何也？有名呼不得，無位可安排，團圞無縫罅，恁麼也不得，不恁麼也不得，恁麼不恁麼總不得。大眾且道，正恁麼時如何？若道得，不枉常檀越夫婦攜男元白來山營齋供佛飯僧，請山埜陞座露布葛藤，直得透頂徹底，搜括將來，本無一個元字腳；若或未然，不得辜負信心。還委悉麼？意氣不從天地得，靈苗豈被四時催。

Senses.Explanation: Yaoshan brings Shitou his question — the three vehicles I roughly know, the southern direct pointing is still unclear — and Shitou closes every exit: thus it may not be, not-thus it may not be, thus and not-thus together, all may not be. How do you understand it? Yaoshan stands thinking; your conditions are not here — go to Jiangxi and see Master Ma. The closing of exits: Xisou Shaotan raises the source whole — the three vehicles and twelve divisions roughly known, the southern pointing at mind still unlit — Shitou answers with the triple refusal, asks how he takes it, sees him standing lost, and sends him on to Master Ma; Wuzhun Shifan spends it on the summer retreat — gathering herbs by the square, the sick only multiply; splitting the bushel, breaking the scale, disputes grow — and only after the triple refusal does Jingzhan share the enjoyment at the place of no connection: dwelling together, forgetting this and forgetting that, neither real nor empty, the two gruels giving coarse strength — do you understand?; Cishou Huaishen at the patron's lecture — Shakyamuni shutting his room already wades in words, Vimalakirti's silence has already shown the awl — you must trust the triple refusal: turn around inside it and you drag the patriarch's nostril back, skipping the ancient buddha's stairs. The price of passing: Wuming Huijing prices the passage — the mind holding one law is uneasy everywhere; the mind with no law still muddles on; set on neither — what is it after all? Hence the triple refusal: pass beyond the three sentences and you are naturally no different from a buddha — walk sideways or straight, none can block you, killing does not scare you, living does not scare you; Danxia Tianran sets a questioner in his own hall to say the triple — and answers him: you too will stop at saying it here; Huanzhu Ming rounds it seamless — if sages know it they match commoners, if commoners get it they are sages: no name to call it by, no seat to set it in, round with no crack — the triple refusal, and what about right at such a time?
